# Simulation : 


**Hypothese**:   
Influence of Higher level grid and splitting heat storages

**Remarks/changes**:   
- Previously in ZORRO I gird and storages were not well defined. 
- The grid is classified into Höchste- und Hochspannung to obtain a clean comparision with the regionalisation model. - The heat storages are sub classified into seasonal and district heating storages. 
- Other parameters remain the same [[2030_BS0001_008]]
